definitions: A strip of leather sewn into the seam between the upper and the sole of a shoe.
A red, swollen mark left on flesh, especially by a blow or pressure.
A reinforced border or edge on a garment or fabric.
examples: The shoemaker attached the welt to the upper.
He had a large welt on his arm where he was stung.
The jacket had a decorative welt on the pocket.
